name: vox-crewlove-drake-3-reverb-return
notes: Crew Love (Drake) vocal chain, stock Reverb on a return at 100% wet: decay 2.7 s, HiFilter 5.3 kHz, HiShelf Gain 0.41 (dark tail). Vocal track send to this return: -24 dB (DiffVox put reverb about 28 dB under the direct vocal; a few dB added because Live's Reverb is quieter than the model's). Only the listed params were set; others are Reverb defaults. Apply to a return device by name with dial or set_parameters_by_name (save_plugin_recipe cannot snapshot return tracks).
